notes.title: Torches of Fate Tower Expansion
notes.content:
We have finally released the Tower Expansion for Torches of Fate today, this expansion includes many new features, including game modes, costumes, game fixes, and some changes to the game that were much requested by the earlier adopters.

[h2]The Tower Mode[/h2]
The Tower is now open to challengers! See how far you can climb this alternative game mode with rougelite elements, you can reach this mode by Castle Gaiden once you have Dimitri, Engore, Ramona, and Riley in your party, this mode has unique weapons, armor, monsters to battle, and different character-building from the main game. Beating The Tower will also unlock several things in the base game, including a new merchant, weapons exclusive to the Tower, and a new costume set.

[h2]Monster Loot[/h2]
Monsters in the base game will now drop more loot besides G, keep an eye out to see what new weapons and armor you can find.

[h2]Death's Castle Change[/h2]
We got many complaints about how much of a labyrinth Death's Castle was; it has been completely revamped into being a proper dungeon more in line with the earlier dungeons in the game.

notes.title: Torches of Fate Content Update!
notes.content:
Hey! Letting everyone know we are doing a MASSIVE content update for Torches of Fate!  We will keep you posted as more details get fleshed out and worked on :D

-Adding a bunch of new unique weapons and armor as drops to several different common enemies.

-Redoing Death's Castle to have it be more in line with the previous dungeons, as well make it easier to navigate.

-Adding a new area for a new gameplay mode!  This area you will have special versions of Dimitri, Engore, Riley, and Ramona that you can build and improve as you climb the tower.  In this rougelike mode you will be able to spend stardust to increase your stats how you see fit.  Getting random weapons, armor, rings and items as you climb.  Be careful, if you perish you will be sent back to the bottom of the tower with just the stats you have leveled and the stardust you have earned!  This mode has all unique weapons and armor from the base game, as well as a special boss, and some new enemies!

notes.title: v1.0.9 Released
notes.content:
We had some notes from someone that the game had no mouse support and that was a problem -- we actually disabled mouse support due to how annoying it can be when you're playing with a keyboard, but didn't realize that mouse support may be a needed accessibility feature.

- We made disabling the mouse optional, now under controls you can enable/disable the mouse.


Enjoy!

notes.title: v1.0.8 Released
notes.content:
- Fixed Artifact Key items being visible in the combat item menu and being able to be used
- Fixed a Spring Boots location in the Off Beaten Path that lands you inside of a wall
- Fixed Gem Grab not charging you to play the mini-game
- Fixed some of the teleportation crystals in the Moon Rift
- Fixed Some of the damage skills and spells Riley and Dimitri had that could be used outside of combat

notes.title: v1.0.7 Released
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue with a ladder in Muscle Tower that prevented access to a room
- Fixed an issue with the Sapphire Crest to correctly display the correct item when purchased
- Fixed an issue with being able to fight Zomok several times potentially soft locking the player
- Fixed Engore's magic cage after the cutscene in Giant's Capital returning randomly afterwards
- Added some gems to be able to reach the max score of 1700 to get the final repeatable reward

notes.title: v1.0.6 Released
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where you could use Taran Temple keys in your inventory which made them vanish
- Fixed a bug with a scene in the Vestments of Protection that would cause a music loading error
- Fixed a music loading bug in the Rory G cutscene in the Frozen Path
- Fixed a bug with going back to Baba Yaga's without a key item crashing the game

notes.title: v1.0.5 Released
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue with a weird transport that could happen in the Hunter's Guild

-Fixed a few dialogue errors as well as added a better hint for a transportation item you can find later in the game

notes.title: v1.0.4 Released
notes.content: - Fixed an issue that allowed you to enter the Milk Cafe without the membership card.

notes.title: v1.0.3 Released
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue that did not allow Dimitri to equip ammo in his offhand for guns of mythic quality.

Ammo can normally be equipped by Dimitri in his offhand slot if he has a gun as his weapon.  There was an issue that some of the mythic rare guns late in the game that wouldn't allow Dimitri to do this.

notes.title: v1.0.2 Released
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that can occur in the heated room in Taran Temple

There was a bug if you exited the heated rooms in Taran Temple at the exact time the timer hit 0:00 it would just keep the screen black and unable to play

notes.title: v1.0.1 Released
notes.content:
- Fixed a game crash due to asset load failure after 4-6 hours
- Added Riley's icon back to the status/task bar


We had a nasty bug that would happen after extended play that would cause the game to fail to load an asset and crash (may happen sooner on slower machines), also some default assets were used for icons around the game's executable and we've remedied that.

As part of this we've also started the process for OSX/Linux support as part of these build changes, don't have a major plan on that yet but depending on interest we may deploy to those platforms.
